title.narrative: Health Systems Strengthening and HIV/AIDS Prevention, Care and Treatment under the President's Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief: Global Reach II

description.narrative: The purpose the Global Reach II program is to collaboratively formulate and deliver high quality solutions across the range of programming required to achieve sustainable HIV epidemic control as guided by the Office of the Global AIDS Coordinator of the U.S. State Department, emphasizing new and innovative approaches pursued jointly with HRSA and other stakeholders. This program aims to assist with translating new science into programming and to mitigate the impact of forces such as global pandemics in the HIV response. Programs and activities are to span health services, structural interventions, and data use and tracking systems, while focusing on these four major categories: HIV Direct Service Delivery, Human Resources for Health, Quality Improvement and Health Systems Strengthening.
